name: Context Arena
intro: Context Arena 展示外部运行的 OpenAI MRCR v2 长上下文结果。该评测把 2、4 或 8 个相同请求及干扰项散布在长对话中，要求模型返回第 N 个目标回答并前置随机哈希；Context Arena 按长度桶报告平均匹配率、128K/1M AUC、Token 效率与成本。
org: Context Arena; OpenAI MRCR; external evaluators
build_method: GPT-4o合成针与干扰项, 2/4/8重复请求, 随机哈希, 8K至1M长度分桶
metric: Mean Match Ratio, AUC@128K, AUC@1M, Model AUC
task_type: 长上下文序数检索, 多轮共指
eval_feature: 2/4/8 needles, 随机哈希门, 每长度桶100题, 外部评测
build_method_en: GPT-4o synthetic needles and distractors, 2/4/8 repeated requests, random hash, 8K-to-1M length bins
eval_feature_en: 2/4/8 needles, random-hash gate, 100 tests per length bin, external evaluation
intro_en: Context Arena presents externally run OpenAI MRCR v2 long-context results. The evaluation scatters 2, 4, or 8 identical requests and distractors through a long conversation, asks the model to return the Nth target response with a random hash prefix, and reports mean match ratio by length bin plus 128K/1M AUC, token efficiency, and cost.
scale_en: Eight length bins from 8K to 1M; 100 tests per bin
metric_en: Mean Match Ratio, AUC@128K, AUC@1M, Model AUC
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Context Arena official methodology/FAQ, the OpenAI MRCR dataset card, and Claude Opus 4.6 System Card Section 2.18.1. OpenAI MRCR v2 inserts 2, 4, or 8 identical requests and their responses among GPT-4o-generated distractors in unique synthetic long conversations; the final query requests a specific ordinal instance and requires a per-test random hash prefix. Context Arena groups cases by o200k_base total length into eight bins from 8K through 1M, with 100 tests per bin. A missing or wrong hash yields zero; otherwise the hash is removed and Python difflib SequenceMatcher produces a 0–1 similarity ratio, averaged as the Mean Match Ratio for the bin. Normalized trapezoidal AUC summarizes performance through 128K, 1M, or the model's completed range, while the dashboard also presents token efficiency and estimated cost. The Claude card uses the hardest 8-needle MRCR v2 variant, reports five-trial internal results, and separately identifies Context Arena results as externally run.
